Guardrail.description:
A guardrail imposed on the use case.

Serves MAS-AIRM §4.8 fn25 ("the guardrails imposed to manage risk") and §5.15, which expects
the *effectiveness* of guardrails to be tested for Generative AI and agents. ``tested`` and
``evidence_ref`` are what makes that expectation checkable.

evidence_ref.description: Evidence id or path for the effectiveness test.
evidence_ref.title: Evidence Ref

Guardrail.title: Guardrail

description:
Agent-specific inventory attributes.

Implements MAS-AIRM §4.8 footnote 25 directly: "for AI agents, relevant attributes may include
agent-specific identifiers, information on the tools and systems the agent can access, its
components, and the guardrails imposed to manage risk". ``human_checkpoints`` serves §5.9(c)
(design for oversight, with escalation when predefined conditions are met) and
``approved_tools`` makes the §5.23(a) tool-usage monitoring checkable against approved scope.

approved_tools.description: Tools and systems the agent may access (MAS-AIRM §4.8 fn25).
approved_tools.title: Approved Tools

systems_accessible.description: Internal or external systems reachable by the agent.
systems_accessible.title: Systems Accessible

components.description: Sub-agents, planners, retrievers and other components (MAS-AIRM §4.8 fn25).
components.title: Components

human_checkpoints.description: Points at which a human must approve or can intervene (MAS-AIRM §5.9(c)).
human_checkpoints.title: Human Checkpoints

max_steps.description: Cap on autonomous steps per task, a §5.2 mitigant.
max_steps.title: Max Steps

can_initiate_external_actions.description: Whether the agent can act on systems of record or third parties (§1.11).
can_initiate_external_actions.title: Can Initiate External Actions

trace_logging.description: Reasoning, actions and tools are logged (MAS-AIRM §5.23(a) and (d)).
trace_logging.title: Trace Logging
